name: signature-agent-bridge
description: OpenAI-compatible local jobs, workflows, and a management console powered by your own Claude subscription.
long_description: The extension starts one local OpenAI-compatible API with durable jobs, workflow templates, buffered completion SSE, and replayable orchestration events. Connect the OpenAI SDK or Pydantic AI, or run native agent work with profile-controlled tools and bypass permissions. Official Claude Code 2.1.260 or later and your own subscription login are required. No provider API key is collected. Data stays in your operating system user data directory.
